According to the site guidance:
- Creating a release: navigate to /<owner>/<repo>/releases/new
- Choose/create the tag with the "Choose a tag" combobox
- Verify the "Previous tag" range
- If no exact notes, prefer "Generate release notes" and review its output; otherwise preserve their text
- Finish with "Publish release" or "Save draft"
